description: Flat metadata schema for individual single-cell amplified genome (SAG) records from uncultured marine microbes, covering isolation, lysis, amplification, sequencing, assembly, annotation, and genome-quality metadata.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual SAG record within the dataset (e.g., SAG_0001).

sample_id.descr: Original sample or collection identifier from which the single cell was isolated.

environment_type.descr: High-level environment category; expected value for this use case is marine.

marine_subenvironment.descr: Specific marine habitat/source, such as surface seawater, deep sea water, coastal water, marine sediment, or plankton-associated.

collection_location.descr: Sampling location as a string, preferably including site name and/or coordinates if available.

collection_latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees; negative values indicate south.

collection_longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees; negative values indicate west.

collection_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below sea surface or sediment surface, as applicable.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) at collection.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at collection in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: pH measured at collection or from corresponding environmental measurement.

oxygen_umol_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if available.

cell_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the individual cell, e.g., microfluidics, FACS, micromanipulation, or dilution-to-extinction.

microfluidics_platform.descr: Specific microfluidics platform or instrument used for single-cell isolation, if applicable.

cell_sorting_or_capture_device.descr: Instrument or device used to capture or dispense single cells, if distinct from the microfluidics platform.

cell_isolation_enrichment.descr: Any pre-enrichment or fractionation step before single-cell isolation, such as filtration size fraction or density separation.

lysis_method.descr: Cell lysis approach used prior to amplification, such as alkaline, thermal, enzymatic, or combined lysis.

lysis_reagents.descr: Key lysis reagents used, reported as a free-text list or concise protocol description.

lysis_temperature_c.descr: Temperature used during lysis in degrees Celsius (°C).

whole_genome_amplification_method.descr: Genome amplification method used; for this workflow typically multiple displacement amplification (MDA).

amplification_polymerase.descr: Polymerase or amplification enzyme used for WGA/MDA, if known.

amplification_protocol_version.descr: Protocol name or version for the amplification workflow.

amplification_reaction_volume_ul.descr: Reaction volume for amplification in microliters (µL).

amplification_starting_material_descript.descr: Description of the starting material for amplification, such as single cell, lysate, or purified DNA.

amplification_temperature_c.descr: Incubation temperature during whole-genome amplification in degrees Celsius (°C).

amplification_qc_passed.descr: Whether amplification yielded material that passed internal QC for downstream sequencing.

amplification_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield after amplification in nanograms (ng), if measured.

amplification_product_concentration_ng_u.descr: Concentration of amplified DNA in ng/µL, if measured.

pcr_screening_marker.descr: Marker gene or assay used to screen amplification success or target taxon, if applicable.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or workflow used for sequencing library construction.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq or MiSeq.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Nominal sequencing read length in base pairs (bp), e.g., 150 for paired-end 150 bp reads.

sequencing_layout.descr: Sequencing layout, such as single-end or paired-end.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for this SAG record, if known.

read_preprocessing_tool.descr: Tool used for adapter trimming, quality filtering, or preprocessing of raw reads.

assembly_software.descr: Primary genome assembler used to reconstruct the SAG genome.

assembly_software_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key non-default assembly parameters or command-line settings used, summarized as free text.

assembly_contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the final assembly.

assembly_total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome size in base pairs (bp).

assembly_n50_bp.descr: N50 contig length in base pairs (bp).

assembly_l50_count.descr: L50 statistic for the assembly, i.e., number of contigs needed to cover 50% of the assembly.

assembly_gc_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled genome, expressed as percent (0-100).

assembly_max_contig_length_bp.descr: Length of the longest contig in base pairs (bp).

mapping_rate_percent.descr: Percentage of reads mapping back to the final assembly, if calculated.

coverage_mean_x.descr: Mean sequencing coverage across the assembly, expressed as fold coverage (x).

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated contamination of the SAG assembly as percent, using the chosen quality-control method.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness as percent, using the chosen quality-control method.

num_single_copy_marker_genes.descr: Number of single-copy marker genes detected for genome quality assessment.

binning_or_curation_method.descr: Method used to curate or clean the assembly, such as manual curation, read-backed curation, or no curation.

annotation_software.descr: Software used for gene prediction and/or genome annotation.

annotation_software_version.descr: Version of the annotation software used.

annotation_database.descr: Reference database used for annotation, if applicable (e.g., KEGG, Pfam, EggNOG, COG).

predicted_protein_count.descr: Number of predicted protein-coding genes in the SAG assembly.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Most specific taxonomic assignment available for the SAG, ideally including genus or species where justified.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used to assign taxonomy, such as marker-gene classification, GTDB-Tk, or phylogenomic placement.

ecological_role.descr: Known or inferred ecological role of the organism, such as phototroph, heterotroph, symbiont, or nutrient cycler.

functional_notes.descr: Brief free-text notes on notable metabolic or ecological features inferred from the genome.

public_accession.descr: Public database accession for the assembly or raw reads, such as GenBank, ENA, or SRA accession.
